_comment: OPTIMAL random-init control for K562. Test Pearson 0.7393 (full dataset, n=19670) vs 0.6972 for the original inherited-recipe baseline, a gain of +0.0421. This is the one cell where retuning clearly worked: the validation gain was ~14 SE and it transferred to test (val 0.7361 -> test 0.7393). Key change is the learning rate, 3e-3 rather than the inherited 1e-3, plus batch 256 rather than 32 and dropout 0.4. Single-stage: with --no_freeze_backbone, 'stage 2' is only an LR drop.
_selection: Selected on FULL-DATASET validation Pearson (scripts/test_ft_model_mpra.py --split val), never on the batch-averaged in-log metric and never on test. Test was scored once, afterwards, for reporting only.
